summary: Prioritize high-stakes military defense and warrior heroics for maximum CTR and initial views (e.g., Rani Durgavati, Gurjara-Pratihara).
Fix opening hooks on high-CTR videos: Rani Durgavati drove 288 views but had the worst retention (12%), signaling early viewer drop-off.
Invest in spy, betrayals, and revolution narratives; Kakori achieved the highest retention (25.08%) and longest average watch time (330s).
Avoid dry scientific/architectural titles (e.g., Iron Pillar metallurgy) as they fail to generate clicks despite decent retention.
Title structure must include strong emotional triggers ('वीरांगना', 'अनकही गाथा') paired with action emojis.
Keep future titles under 60 characters to ensure full visibility on mobile screens.
Align the first 30 seconds of the script directly with the dramatic promise made in the thumbnail and title.
